findings.finding: the current create endpoint persists caller-authored assessment fields and is not an authoritative Evidence Build Job
no signed required-facts or evidence-selection profiles exist for the eight Workshop modules
aip_evidence has no revision or revoke lifecycle and the initial migration grants runtime UPDATE and DELETE without a discovered mutation guard
the Bundle store does not evaluate purpose, marking, license, redaction or minimum-disclosure policy when selecting evidence

decisions: retain the existing EvidenceBundle revision table as the persistence authority
add a generic Build Job and profile resolver instead of allowing Workshop to calculate authoritative coverage
publish eight module required-facts profiles as signed domain or solution artifacts resolved through exact installation locks
close Evidence immutability and revoke semantics before implementing source-revoke or hash-drift rebuild behavior
treat the existing create API as a low-level authority command, not W4-01 completion evidence
do not copy evidence payload into Workshop read models or frontend state

verification.interpretation: existing persistence behavior is stable; the missing Build Job and governance are unimplemented requirements rather than current regression failures

nextGate: Review and authorize a generic Evidence Build and governance wave after W3; migrations require the unique migration lease and exact compatibility review.
